title: I converted my whole game to text using Claude, and the result surprised me
author: Annual-Kiwi4096
selftext:
I converted my mobile roguelike into a terminal version with Claude, in one night.

I am the sole developer of Grim Hand, a dark fantasy roguelike RPG for mobile. Last night I asked Claude to port it to the terminal and it did the whole thing. (Well, almost. I had to go over it and fix some stuff and polish the text interface a bit. )

[The turn based fight \(core loop\)](https://preview.redd.it/xvum65fv9hnh1.jpg?width=1600&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=74dc0b7cbeadaa0b4f141e9f8893afa7a1d0d6d8)

Here's another in game screen:  


[Souls selection menu](https://preview.redd.it/3koif0zj9hnh1.jpg?width=1600&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=064fae6512d1fba5863f7d09216bbe8777db127a)

It converted art to funny ASCII art. It recreated all the UI and the menus. So, now I've got a playable text version of the game, which can be released on Steam! 😄



[I love what it did to the goblin :-\)](https://preview.redd.it/tyjyyf1g9hnh1.jpg?width=1600&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=a125d454c5c81c03a92fbb8f4c10c8679ee36ee4)

The port itself was easy since I made sure while building the original game that there was a clear separation between the UI layer and the engine. If you're building a turn based game, that's a good idea.

https://preview.redd.it/sxxl5cqq9hnh1.jpg?width=1600&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=ee890125d98fdb6056f525922dea7b846d3c9a47

The [game itself is on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.andreyrub.grim_hand&referrer=utm_source%3Dreddit-commandline%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dtextmode), open testing.  (coming soon to iOS). Free demo and a single unlock, no ads.
